# Mike Nahas for Austin City Council, District 1

> Mike Nahas is a Democrat running for Austin City Council, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 election. He is an economist (Master's in Economics, UT-Austin) who has worked in finance. He accepts no campaign donations.

His full answers to candidate questionnaires from many local organizations are on the Issues & Plans page, in the collapsed section titled "Raw questionnaire answers". Each organization's answers are dated; when two answers cover the same question, prefer the newer one.

## Pages

- [Issues & Plans](https://mike4austin.org/issues.html): his positions, with his questionnaire answers in the collapsed section at the bottom
- [Meet Mike](https://mike4austin.org/meet-mike.html): short biography
- [9 Reasons to Vote for Mike](https://mike4austin.org/reasons.html): his qualifications and record
- [No Donations Accepted. Why?](https://mike4austin.org/no-donations.html): why he self-funds, and where other candidates' money comes from
- [Contact](https://mike4austin.org/contact.html): campaign email addresses
